Results

Gallery: Real Cases, Clear Context

Our gallery is designed to help patients understand the range of outcomes associated with different procedures. Each case is presented with appropriate consent, clinical context and a clear explanation of individual variability.

Home/Gallery

Our imagery commitment

Only genuine, consented clinical images are used. Illustrative stock photography is clearly labelled and never presented as a patient result. Images are never digitally altered to exaggerate treatment outcomes, and before-and-after images use consistent lighting, positioning and camera angles.

Consented cases

Clinical gallery

Each case study includes the procedure performed, the timeframe, the patient’s treatment goals (described with consent), relevant follow-up information and a clear statement that individual results vary.
